findings.chapter: Ch. 2 (What Actually Happens During Inference), Fig. 2.1 caption
findings.evidence: PDF p. 43: "[ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED] — the schematic is drawn from the documented mechanism ([1P][FACT], Ch 4), and the band grouping is a teaching simplification, not a measurement." Compare the parallel Fig. 1.1 caption (PDF p. 34): "the schematic is drawn from the documented mechanism ([1P][FACT]: the per-token K/V accounting of the DeepSeek-V2 MLA report, arXiv:2405.04434), and the 64-head geometry it abbreviates carries its own label ([canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION], Ch 4, Table 4-2), not a vendor checkpoint".
findings.issue: The Fig. 2.1 caption tags "Ch 4" as the locus of a [1P][FACT]. Per the book's own rules (Ch 4 Table 4-2 Note 1; Preface evidence panel), [1P] means first-party vendor documentation, whereas Ch 4 is the book's own canonical-scenario chapter whose inputs are [canonical scenario], not [1P]; Ch 4 also does not document the prefill/decode/KV mechanism the schematic depicts (that is §2.1 and Ch 3). Fig. 1.1's parallel caption shows the intended pattern — a named [1P] source for the mechanism and a separate "Ch 4, Table 4-2" pointer for the scenario geometry — so the compressed parenthetical mislabels the book's own scenario documentation as first-party vendor fact.
findings.fix_instruction: Re-point the mechanism citation to the section that documents it (e.g. "§2.1 / Ch 3") or name a first-party source, and cite "Ch 4, Table 4-2" only for the canonical geometry the figure instantiates, with the matching [canonical scenario] tag.

findings.chapter: Ch. 2 — What Actually Happens During Inference
findings.evidence: while the 35% MFU factor itself is [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION — the book’s planning MFU, benchmark-informed: the [ILLUSTRATIVE] industry range is 30–40%, and the 35% point is the book’s chosen planning value, with 25/35/45% sensitivity in Ch 8, Table 8-1].
findings.issue: Malformed evidence label: the '[canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION' pair has no closing bracket after ASSUMPTION; the bracket is only closed after the entire explanatory clause, so the label does not follow the book's stated convention that the two tags are set with no space and stay on one line, and the pair is unparseable/ambiguous.
findings.fix_instruction: Replace with '[canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION] — the book’s planning MFU, benchmark-informed: ...' and end the sentence with ordinary punctuation, not a repurposed label bracket.
